context.id: Sejarawan Procopius mencatat menara-menara benteng Sycae diisi penuh mayat hingga atap karena kuburan massal tak mampu menampung korban.
context.en: Procopius recorded that city rampart towers were packed to the roof with corpses as graves completely overflowed.

context.id: Tahun 541: Kapal-kapal gandum pembayar upeti membawa tikus dan kutu pes dari pedalaman Afrika menuju muara Mediterania.
context.en: Year 541: Grain tribute vessels carried plague-infested rodents from African trade routes to Mediterranean ports.

context.id: Kaisar Yustinianus I terjangkit pes bubonik namun pulih; roda pemerintahan sempat dikendalikan sepenuhnya oleh Maharani Theodora.
context.en: Emperor Justinian contracted the bubonic plague and survived; Empress Theodora assumed direct administrative control.

context.id: Epidemi menghancurkan logistik pasukan Romawi Timur, menghentikan penyatuan kembali wilayah Mediterania barat.
context.en: The epidemic decimated Byzantine legions, permanently ending efforts to reclaim Western Roman territories.
